name: Calendar
complete-description:
Events from any ICS feed — the export format Google Calendar, Outlook, iCloud and Nextcloud can all publish, with no account to connect and no API key to manage.

It hands over raw events and nothing else: what's on, and when. It has no notion of "today", no weeks, no grid — the theme already knows the device's own date and is the one deciding what a calendar looks like and which events belong on screen. Two window settings say how far back and how far forward to read the feed, since a calendar has no natural end of its own.

The fiddly part is getting dates right across providers, and that's handled here: times written in another timezone are converted properly (including Outlook's non-standard Windows zone names), all-day events stay as whole calendar days rather than being pinned to an instant and sliding onto the wrong day, and multi-day events report the last day they're actually on. Cancelled events are dropped. Repeating events are skipped rather than guessed at.
